fills.researcher_notes: The operating entity is Rio Bravo Pipeline Company, LLC (originally a NextDecade subsidiary, formed to build the 4.5 Bcf/d twin-pipe line from Agua Dulce to NextDecade's Rio Grande LNG at the Port of Brownsville). MERGER-CHURN NOTE (gotcha 4): in February 2020 NextDecade and Enbridge signed a definitive agreement for Enbridge to acquire Rio Bravo Pipeline Co. LLC for up to $25M cash, $15M at closing and the balance contingent on Rio Grande LNG reaching a positive final investment decision -- OGJ's 'Enbridge buys NextDecade's Rio Bravo pipeline' (14167787) and naturalgasintel.com's 'Enbridge Expands Role in LNG Exports with Deal to Buy Rio Bravo Pipeline' are two independent trade-press outlets reporting the same deal terms and entity name. That FID condition was met: OGJ's later 'Enbridge eyes Rio Bravo Pipeline construction following RGLNG FID' (14297351) reports Rio Grande LNG's July 2023 FID and Enbridge adding $1.2 billion of secured capital to Rio Bravo Pipeline construction in the following quarter -- confirming the acquisition closed and Enbridge now owns/operates the project, with commercial operations targeted for 2026. The entity's legal name is unchanged by the ownership change (still 'Rio Bravo Pipeline Company, LLC'), matching the sheet's existing Owner value 'Rio Bravo Pipeline Co LLC [100.%]' -- current parent is Enbridge Inc., not NextDecade, as of the 2023 FID; NextDecade instead holds a 20-year firm-transportation capacity contract on the line. Operator staged as the project entity itself, consistent with how other project-company Operators are recorded in this tracker (e.g. Valley Crossing Pipeline, LLC in this same brief).
